decisionBox.changed: Position moves from ADD to REDUCE, and the reduction is SYNTHETIC - the spot core is not sold. What changed is measurable and one-directional. Six hours ago price sat above all sixteen exponential moving averages across 15m, 1H, 4H and daily; it now sits below twelve of them, holding only the four daily EMAs. The 4H frame that morning called 'one candle from its first bullish cross since 06 September' did not cross: RSI fell 52.46 to 45.32 and the histogram RE-WIDENED from -7.47 to -24.88. Hourly ATR expanded again, 406.46 to 473.05, a third consecutive session of expansion. Against that, one thing genuinely improved: this is the first real deleveraging of the week. Open interest fell 1.53 percent to 2,137,774,050 USD, funding cooled 15.82 percent to +0.0000783849355312, and the account ratio eased 1.26 to 1.24 - where morning measured a flush with open interest DOWN only 0.50 percent and funding UP 71 percent, i.e. pure replacement. So the crowd is genuinely smaller now, which is why this report hedges instead of selling. The add gate falls hard from 79,768.0 to 78,977.5 because after a 1,610.8-point break the question is no longer whether BTC can make a new high, it is whether it can reclaim its own hourly averages.

liquidityMagnet.note: METHOD NOTE, because the literal nearest buckets are misleading here. Spot at 78,744.5 is wedged inside the 78,600-78,800 short-liquidation band it just squeezed through, so the buckets immediately either side of it - 78,700 below and 78,800 above - are where price IS, not where it is being pulled. The fields above therefore report the nearest clusters with material mass outside that band: 78,900 above (47,479 USD) and 78,100 below (933,354 USD). Pull is DOWN on a 19.7-to-1 mass differential, with the honest caveat that the 78,100 mass is REALISED - those longs are already liquidated and cannot be run again. What makes the pull credible this time, and did not in morning's read, is that positioning did NOT rebuild: open interest fell 1.53 percent to 2,137,774,050 USD (33.1 million of notional genuinely removed, against morning's 0.50 percent), funding fell 15.82 percent to +0.0000783849355312 (morning's rose 71 percent), and the account ratio spiked to 1.28 in the 15:00 UTC flush hour before easing to 1.24. Dip buyers stepped in at the low and are already trimming.

calibration.rollingRecord: 8 wins, 8 losses across the last 16 graded sessions. Morning's session grades a LOSS on the trade and a WIN on both written gates, which is the exact mirror of midnight six hours earlier - midnight's gate lost while its discretionary tranche won. Since 07 September the chain reads L, L, L, L, W, L, L. The transferable point is not that one method beats the other; it is that across two consecutive sessions the gate and the discretionary call disagreed and the one that was right flipped. That is the statistical signature of a range with no persistent edge, and it argues for smaller size on both, not for picking a side.
calibration.note: Full accounting of morning's three written levels. THE ADD GATE REFUSED, AND SAVED 931.1 POINTS. It required a settled 1H close above 79,768.0; the session high was 79,675.6 at 13:00 UTC, missing by 92.4 points, and the best settled hourly close was 79,609.2, missing by 158.8. Price then fell 1,610.8 points to 78,064.8. Morning raised that gate from midnight's 79,648.1 precisely because the lower level had fired and failed on a thin 51.5-point margin, and the 92.4-point miss is the whole margin of that decision - at midnight's gate this session would have bought the top. THE REDUCE GATE REFUSED, BY 44.0 POINTS. It required a settled 1H close below 78,551.3; the lowest settled hourly close was 78,595.3 at 15:00 UTC. But the LOW was 78,064.8 - 486.5 points through the level - so the gate survived only because morning specified a settled close rather than a touch. THE INVALIDATION AT 78,265.0 WAS PIERCED, by 200.2 points on the wick, with no settled close below it either. THE DECLINED RESTING STOP AT 78,500.0 WOULD HAVE BEEN FILLED, 435.2 points above the low, and price marks 78,744.5 - so declining it was right by 244.5 points, the second session running that refusal has paid. Net: two gates right, one wick-pierced invalidation, and the discretionary trade wrong. Morning bought 4.00 USDT of spot at 79,344.2 and it marks 78,744.5, 599.7 points and 0.76 percent offside, roughly -0.030 USDT. The specific error to log is that morning's written analysis was correct in every particular - it named the rebuilt positioning, the rising funding, the negative ETF print and the hostile macro, and then bought anyway on the argument that a shakeout which breaks no structure deserves a tranche. It bought at 79,344.2, dead inside the 78,000-79,500 band the lesson log has now blamed for six consecutive losing entries. The band is the constraint. Nothing inside it is worth paying for.
